name: Harris County, TX
findings: Harris County has 14,624 nonprofit organizations. 5,427 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4,196 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Harris County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
